details.description: Whether it's a swing of the bat, taking the extra base, or chasing down a ball in the gap, there are players who can change a game in one move. These skills are a can’t miss presence on the field, and they require a shoe specifically engineered to support speed and power – the FuelCell 4040v8. A no-sew TPU and mesh upper is designed to conform to the shape of the foot, for a supportive fit with a lightweight feel. A full-length FuelCell midsole with a 7-spike outsole provides propulsive feeling responsiveness and superior traction on natural playing surfaces.
